# NotesPrep

> Download Class 9 & 10 PDF notes and prepare for entry tests.

NotesPrep is an educational resource website dedicated to providing high-quality PDF notes and study materials for students in Class 9 and Class 10, primarily focusing on the FBISE curriculum. The platform aims to help students achieve high scores by offering comprehensive notes, practice MCQs, solved exercises, and resources for entry test preparation. It serves as a one-stop shop for academic success, covering subjects like Mathematics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, and English.

The core value proposition of NotesPrep lies in its accessibility and relevance to students preparing for both board exams and competitive entry tests. Users can easily download subject-specific notes, often chapter-wise, to aid their studies. The inclusion of entry test preparation materials, such as mock tests and MCQs for various exams like NET Engineering, further enhances its utility. This makes NotesPrep a valuable tool for students aiming for academic excellence and admission into higher education institutions.

## Core Resources

- [NotesPrep: Class 9, 10 PDF Notes & Entry Test Resources 2026](https://notesprep.com/): Access Class 9 & 10 PDF notes, entry test prep, and MCQs.
- [Class 9 PDF Notes](https://notesprep.com/class9/): Download comprehensive PDF notes for all Class 9 subjects.
- [Class 10 PDF Notes](https://notesprep.com/class10/): Download comprehensive PDF notes for all Class 10 subjects.
